description: COBRA application, page 1: the form's ruled grid holds 25 choice circles and a logo's curves, which read as the dots and wedges of a chart, so the whole form came out as one picture with its text in a list. A grid of labels with no figure in it is a form's: it stays tables. The dependents block, which the form prints three times (labels over blank cells), is one table with a column for each label and a row for each dependent, not three repeats of its labels (#281). Its choice circles with words right of them are radio buttons named by those words, grouped under their headings: the coverage lists, the event list and the eligibility status are separate groups (#281). The circles under the captions MALE FEMALE MARRIED SINGLE DIVORCED, and the dependents' MALE and FEMALE, are not yet found: the caption is a table cell, and the cell reader would have to give each circle its own word (#281 follow-up).

cells: SECTION I - INFORMATION REGARDING YOUR EMPLOYER
